svg.aria-label: Advanced animated cyberpunk ASCII GitHub profile card for shashanthnetha
svg.title: Cyberpunk ASCII profile — animated SVG
svg.desc: Original ASCII artwork and right-side profile content retained at 1125 by 536 pixels. The animation combines terminal typing, decoded header text, numeric count-ups, falling character rain, chromatic glitch bursts, scan wipes, particles, orbiting satellite, equalizer bars, language bars, and a comet border.

g.text: SYS://CORE ONLINE • SVG + CSS MOTION • 16s LOOP
